name: singit
description: SingIt MCP for Codex with your SingIt key: paid chat and web tools inside the key's daily and per-request limits, and skills to read your limits and receipts. Set SINGIT_API_KEY before starting Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Paid tools inside your SingIt key's limits; limits and receipts skills
interface.longDescription: Adds SingIt's remote MCP server with your SingIt key from SINGIT_API_KEY (Codex does not start the server if it is unset): paid chat, web search and data tools charged to a key whose daily and per-request limits the owner sets and SingIt's server checks. Skills show your limits and receipts. For the free tools without a key, use `codex mcp add singit --url https://app.singitai.app/mcp` instead.
